title: candidate.document_uploaded.v1
description: A candidate finished uploading a document. The document itself travels as an object reference rather than as bytes, per ADR-0004: an event carrying a CV would put a CV into every consumer's retention policy.

storage_key.description: The object key. Reading it needs a scoped, short-lived grant that this event does not confer.

media_type.description: The declared type, so extraction can refuse one it cannot read without fetching it first.

byte_size.description: Size in bytes, so a consumer can refuse an oversized document before downloading it.
